steps.summary: Signed in to EspoCRM as admin and opened the Opportunities list (http://127.0.0.1:8097/#Opportunity), which shows 3 records ("1–3 / 3"). All three names start with "Seed:": "Seed: training package", "Seed: pilot expansion", "Seed: annual support renewal". Nothing was modified.

The Opportunity was NOT saved — no record was created, so there is no record ID to report. I was still on /#Opportunity/create with the form filled when the turn cap hit. Verified on the live form (last snapshot of #main): Name = "fwec1-n3 Bench Opportunity", Amount = "12,500.00" (USD shown), Close Date = "12/31/2026" (picked from the date picker, not typed), Description = "Bench opportunity for run fwec1-n3", and the Account field textbox reads "Bench Account" — but the Account link and the Assigned User link were NOT demonstrably committed (the Account select dialog was opened and a "Bench Account" row link was clicked, yet the field still renders as a plain textbox with my typed text and no chip/badge; the Assigned User field was typed as "Bench Assignee" but the suggestion list was never confirmed closed with a picked option — the last snapshot shows it as a textbox containing my text, still [active]). I never clicked Save, so nothing was modified on the server. Claimed values for Account/Assigned User are unconfirmed; the record does not exist.

values.account_field_unconfirmed: Bench Account (text typed; link not confirmed committed)
values.assigned_user_field_unconfirmed: Bench Assignee (text typed; link not confirmed committed)
